report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-14 around 09:10 IST, users reported stale mutual fund portfolio valuations and P&L showing yesterday's values, while stock valuations were normal. Investigation revealed that the nightly mutual fund NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13 did not update market-data-service, leaving NAV age at ~32-35 hours and serving NAVs dated 2026-10-12. portfolio-service had been falling back to last available NAVs since before 07:46 IST (02:16 UTC). An 09:10 IST (03:40 UTC) deployment to portfolio-service coincided with peak morning usage and user complaints, but was ruled out as the root cause.
report.rootCauseStatement: The overnight mutual fund NAV import failed to ingest 2026-10-13 NAV data into market-data-service, leaving NAV age at over 31 hours and causing market-data-service to serve stale NAVs from 2026-10-12. Consequently, portfolio-service fell back to stale mutual fund valuations across user portfolios.

hypotheses.cause: Overnight mutual fund NAV import failed or was delayed, leaving market-data-service with stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 and causing portfolio-service to fall back to yesterday's values.
hypotheses.rationale: market-data-service nav_age_s was monotonically increasing from ~31.9 hours (114,960s) at 02:00 UTC to ~34.8 hours at 04:55 UTC. portfolio-service explicitly logged warnings starting at 02:16 UTC indicating fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12). Real-time stock price streaming remained fresh (price_age_s ~2s), matching the user symptom that only mutual fund holdings were stale.

hypotheses.cause: Deployment CHG-48221 to portfolio-service at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST), which included a valuation code refactor, introduced a regression in mutual fund valuation calculation.
hypotheses.rationale: Although CHG-48221 was deployed at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST) when user reports surfaced, portfolio-service running version 7.2.0 was already warning about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 as early as 02:16 UTC, and nav_age_s in market-data-service was already over 31 hours at 02:00 UTC. Valuation error rates did not elevate post-deploy.

facts.statement: market-data-service nav_age_s was 114,960 seconds (~31.9 hours) at 2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z and climbed monotonically to 125,460 seconds (~34.85 hours) by 04:55:00.000Z without resetting.

portfolio-service logged repeated warnings starting at 2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z on version 7.2.0 stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for X holdings (nav_date=2026-10-12); showing last available NAV'.
portfolio-service price_age_s remained normal between 1.58s and 2.46s (mean 2.01s) throughout 02:00 to 05:00 UTC.
portfolio-service valuation_errors metric remained low across 02:00 to 05:00 UTC, averaging 0.94 count/min.
Cache hit rate across all keyspaces (including nav keyspace at 94.5%) remained healthy and stable throughout the incident window.
portfolio-service was deployed to version 7.3.0 under CHG-48221 at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z (09:10 IST).
Past incident PIR-2001 documented identical symptoms caused by AMFI publishing NAVs after the 23:30 IST import schedule, resolved via manual nav-import trigger.
job-scheduler did not trigger or run any nav-import job between 02:00 and 05:00 UTC.

inferences.statement: The nightly AMFI NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13 did not populate market-data-service with 2026-10-13 NAVs, leaving mutual fund prices stuck on 2026-10-12.
CHG-48221 was not the cause of stale portfolio valuations, as NAV staleness and fallback warnings existed in version 7.2.0 over an hour before the deployment.
Stock valuations remained accurate because live stock price ingestion was functioning properly with sub-3s latencies.

assumptions.statement: Users did not notice or report stale fund valuations prior to 09:10 IST due to low app traffic before market open.
AMFI delayed publishing the daily NAV file past 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13, or job-scheduler missed the trigger.

timeline.event: Scheduled execution time for daily nav-import job to fetch mutual fund NAVs from amfi-nav-feed.
Investigation window begins. market-data-service nav_age_s is already ~31.9 hours (114,960s), indicating no NAV updates since 2026-10-12.
portfolio-service (v7.2.0) logs warnings that NAVs are older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and falls back to last available NAV.
portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 promotes v7.3.0 to production. User morning traffic rises and customer complaints begin.
Incident INC-2249 opened as SEV2 by Customer support lead.
market-data-service nav_age_s reaches ~34.8 hours (125,460s) with market-data-service continuing to serve nav_date=2026-10-12.

confidence.rationale: Multiple independent signals confirm NAV data staleness originated from missing 2026-10-13 AMFI imports in market-data-service rather than portfolio-service deployment regressions. Monotonic metric growth of nav_age_s to >34 hours and pre-deployment warnings on portfolio-service v7.2.0 firmly establish the cause.

gaps.description: Logs and job run history for job-scheduler and market-data-service between 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z and 2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z were not directly queried due to tool call budget limits.
gaps.impact: Cannot distinguish whether the 23:30 IST import job failed due to AMFI publishing late (as in PIR-2001) or if the scheduler missed triggering the job, though the operational remediation remains identical.

recommendedActions.action: Manually trigger the nav-import job via job-scheduler to ingest the latest AMFI NAV file into market-data-service and flush stale NAV cache entries.
recommendedActions.rationale: Restores current NAVs (dated 2026-10-13) in market-data-service and resolves stale mutual fund valuations across portfolio-service, identical to the fix for PIR-2001.
recommendedActions.verification: Confirm market-data-service metric nav_age_s resets to <3600s, NAV lookups serve 2026-10-13, and portfolio-service ceases logging 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day'.

recommendedActions.action: Configure an automated alert on market-data-service nav_age_s > 86400s (24 hours) and add scheduled morning retries (e.g., at 06:00 IST and 08:00 IST) if the 23:30 IST import does not yield new NAVs.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents delayed upstream AMFI publications from going unaddressed until active customer trading hours.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify test alert fires in pre-production when nav_age_s exceeds 24 hours, and verify scheduler triggers retry job on stale NAV detection.

recommendedActions.action: Implement a fallback ingestion source or secondary scraper for mutual fund NAVs when the primary AMFI feed is delayed.
recommendedActions.rationale: Reduces external single-point dependency on the primary AMFI file upload timeline.
recommendedActions.verification: Simulate feed publication delays and observe automatic failover to the backup NAV provider.

report.justification: The investigation conclusively establishes the root cause as stale mutual fund NAV data in market-data-service (~32 to ~35 hours old, dated 2026-10-12). Although the investigation completed without formal critic review, metric ev_4 proves nav_age_s was already climbing from 31.9 hours at 02:00 UTC, and log ev_11 proves portfolio-service v7.2.0 was already warning about stale NAVs at 02:16 UTC, conclusively ruling out the 03:40 UTC deployment CHG-48221.

No deployments, configuration changes, or feature-flag changes occurred for cache, job-scheduler, or market-data-service during the scope window 2026-10-13T20:00:00.000Z to 2026-10-14T05:00:00.000Z. An earlier feature flag change occurred on job-scheduler on 2026-10-12T09:12:34.839Z (CHG-48432, portfolio_insights_v2 rollout).

The deployment CHG-48221 coincided precisely with the reported start of customer complaints (09:10 IST / 03:40 UTC), and specifically touched 'valuation code refactor', making it a strong potential cause for the stale or incorrect mutual fund values reported on the portfolio screen.

Past incident PIR-2001 (2026-09-24, SEV3, 'Fund NAVs not updated: AMFI published NAVs late') exhibited identical user symptoms ('Portfolio showed previous-day fund values in the morning'). In that incident, AMFI published the NAV file after the 23:30 IST import window, leaving market-data-service with previous-day NAVs until manually re-run at 11:40 IST.

# Investigation report: Portfolio shows yesterday's values

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.90 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-14 around 09:10 IST, users reported stale mutual fund portfolio valuations and P&L showing yesterday's values, while stock valuations were normal. Investigation revealed that the nightly mutual fund NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13 did not update market-data-service, leaving NAV age at ~32-35 hours and serving NAVs dated 2026-10-12. portfolio-service had been falling back to last available NAVs since before 07:46 IST (02:16 UTC). An 09:10 IST (03:40 UTC) deployment to portfolio-service coincided with peak morning usage and user complaints, but was ruled out as the root cause.

**Root cause:** The overnight mutual fund NAV import failed to ingest 2026-10-13 NAV data into market-data-service, leaving NAV age at over 31 hours and causing market-data-service to serve stale NAVs from 2026-10-12. Consequently, portfolio-service fell back to stale mutual fund valuations across user portfolios.

## Hypotheses
1. **Overnight mutual fund NAV import failed or was delayed, leaving market-data-service with stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 and causing portfolio-service to fall back to yesterday's values.** — `market-data-service`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.90, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_8, ev_9, ev_11, ev_12, ev_14] · Contradicting: none
   - market-data-service nav_age_s was monotonically increasing from ~31.9 hours (114,960s) at 02:00 UTC to ~34.8 hours at 04:55 UTC. portfolio-service explicitly logged warnings starting at 02:16 UTC indicating fund NAVs were older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12). Real-time stock price streaming remained fresh (price_age_s ~2s), matching the user symptom that only mutual fund holdings were stale.
2. **Deployment CHG-48221 to portfolio-service at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST), which included a valuation code refactor, introduced a regression in mutual fund valuation calculation.** — `portfolio-service`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.10, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_6, ev_10] · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_5, ev_8, ev_11]
   - Although CHG-48221 was deployed at 03:40 UTC (09:10 IST) when user reports surfaced, portfolio-service running version 7.2.0 was already warning about stale NAVs dated 2026-10-12 as early as 02:16 UTC, and nav_age_s in market-data-service was already over 31 hours at 02:00 UTC. Valuation error rates did not elevate post-deploy.

## Facts
- market-data-service nav_age_s was 114,960 seconds (~31.9 hours) at 2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z and climbed monotonically to 125,460 seconds (~34.85 hours) by 04:55:00.000Z without resetting. [ev_4]
- portfolio-service logged repeated warnings starting at 2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z on version 7.2.0 stating 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day for X holdings (nav_date=2026-10-12); showing last available NAV'. [ev_9, ev_11]
- portfolio-service price_age_s remained normal between 1.58s and 2.46s (mean 2.01s) throughout 02:00 to 05:00 UTC. [ev_8]
- portfolio-service valuation_errors metric remained low across 02:00 to 05:00 UTC, averaging 0.94 count/min. [ev_5]
- Cache hit rate across all keyspaces (including nav keyspace at 94.5%) remained healthy and stable throughout the incident window. [ev_7]
- portfolio-service was deployed to version 7.3.0 under CHG-48221 at 2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z (09:10 IST). [ev_6, ev_10]
- Past incident PIR-2001 documented identical symptoms caused by AMFI publishing NAVs after the 23:30 IST import schedule, resolved via manual nav-import trigger. [ev_1, ev_14]
- job-scheduler did not trigger or run any nav-import job between 02:00 and 05:00 UTC. [ev_2, ev_15]

## Inferences
- The nightly AMFI NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13 did not populate market-data-service with 2026-10-13 NAVs, leaving mutual fund prices stuck on 2026-10-12. [ev_3, ev_4, ev_11, ev_12]
- CHG-48221 was not the cause of stale portfolio valuations, as NAV staleness and fallback warnings existed in version 7.2.0 over an hour before the deployment. [ev_6, ev_11]
- Stock valuations remained accurate because live stock price ingestion was functioning properly with sub-3s latencies. [ev_8]

## Assumptions
- Users did not notice or report stale fund valuations prior to 09:10 IST due to low app traffic before market open.
- AMFI delayed publishing the daily NAV file past 23:30 IST on 2026-10-13, or job-scheduler missed the trigger.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z (2026-10-13 23:30 IST)** Scheduled execution time for daily nav-import job to fetch mutual fund NAVs from amfi-nav-feed. [ev_3]
- **2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z (2026-10-14 07:30 IST)** Investigation window begins. market-data-service nav_age_s is already ~31.9 hours (114,960s), indicating no NAV updates since 2026-10-12. [ev_4]
- **2026-10-14T02:16:24.606Z (2026-10-14 07:46 IST)** portfolio-service (v7.2.0) logs warnings that NAVs are older than 1 trading day (nav_date=2026-10-12) and falls back to last available NAV. [ev_11]
- **2026-10-14T03:40:00.000Z (2026-10-14 09:10 IST)** portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 promotes v7.3.0 to production. User morning traffic rises and customer complaints begin. [ev_6, ev_10]
- **2026-10-14T04:10:00.000Z (2026-10-14 09:40 IST)** Incident INC-2249 opened as SEV2 by Customer support lead.
- **2026-10-14T04:55:00.000Z (2026-10-14 10:25 IST)** market-data-service nav_age_s reaches ~34.8 hours (125,460s) with market-data-service continuing to serve nav_date=2026-10-12. [ev_4, ev_12]

## Confidence
0.90: Multiple independent signals confirm NAV data staleness originated from missing 2026-10-13 AMFI imports in market-data-service rather than portfolio-service deployment regressions. Monotonic metric growth of nav_age_s to >34 hours and pre-deployment warnings on portfolio-service v7.2.0 firmly establish the cause.

## Gaps
- Logs and job run history for job-scheduler and market-data-service between 2026-10-13T18:00:00.000Z and 2026-10-14T02:00:00.000Z were not directly queried due to tool call budget limits. (impact: Cannot distinguish whether the 23:30 IST import job failed due to AMFI publishing late (as in PIR-2001) or if the scheduler missed triggering the job, though the operational remediation remains identical.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Manually trigger the nav-import job via job-scheduler to ingest the latest AMFI NAV file into market-data-service and flush stale NAV cache entries. [ev_1, ev_4, ev_11, ev_14]
  - Why: Restores current NAVs (dated 2026-10-13) in market-data-service and resolves stale mutual fund valuations across portfolio-service, identical to the fix for PIR-2001.
  - Verify: Confirm market-data-service metric nav_age_s resets to <3600s, NAV lookups serve 2026-10-13, and portfolio-service ceases logging 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day'.
- **[next]** Configure an automated alert on market-data-service nav_age_s > 86400s (24 hours) and add scheduled morning retries (e.g., at 06:00 IST and 08:00 IST) if the 23:30 IST import does not yield new NAVs. [ev_1, ev_4, ev_15]
  - Why: Prevents delayed upstream AMFI publications from going unaddressed until active customer trading hours.
  - Verify: Verify test alert fires in pre-production when nav_age_s exceeds 24 hours, and verify scheduler triggers retry job on stale NAV detection.
- **[later]** Implement a fallback ingestion source or secondary scraper for mutual fund NAVs when the primary AMFI feed is delayed. [ev_1, ev_3]
  - Why: Reduces external single-point dependency on the primary AMFI file upload timeline.
  - Verify: Simulate feed publication delays and observe automatic failover to the backup NAV provider.

## Justification
The investigation conclusively establishes the root cause as stale mutual fund NAV data in market-data-service (~32 to ~35 hours old, dated 2026-10-12). Although the investigation completed without formal critic review, metric ev_4 proves nav_age_s was already climbing from 31.9 hours at 02:00 UTC, and log ev_11 proves portfolio-service v7.2.0 was already warning about stale NAVs at 02:16 UTC, conclusively ruling out the 03:40 UTC deployment CHG-48221.

Cited evidence: ev_1, ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_5, ev_6, ev_7, ev_8, ev_9, ev_10, ev_11, ev_12, ev_14, ev_15
Investigation window: 2026-10-14 07:30 IST to 2026-10-14 10:30 IST

payload.summary: conclusive: The overnight mutual fund NAV import failed to ingest 2026-10-13 NAV data into market-data-service, leaving NAV age at over 31 hours and causing market-data-service to serve stale NAVs from 2026-10-12. Consequently, portfolio-service fell back to stale mutual fund valuations across user portfolios.
